release.reason: No refs/tags in any of three official simulator repository snapshots

distribution.reason: Migrated credential/build/lifecycle patches and NOR/platform stub have no verified grant (NOASSERTION); actual-content/source-delivery and crypto qualification pending. Local research only.

constraints: Linux amd64/glibc 2.41; one in-process statically linked module; no FPGA/HSM or network peer. UDP loopback port 17425 is unused on RPC_CLIENT_LOCAL.

SO and user PINs are fixed to fnord, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 with all-zero 16-byte salt and 2000 iterations. Not a general credential store. Optional caller PIN controls must match; C_InitToken/C_InitPIN/C_SetPIN remain unsupported.

Persistent 512-KiB file NOR simulator under /var/lib/p11lab/cryptech; no hardware protection, atomicity, concurrency or wear claims. Bad-PIN delay is disabled by the migrated stub; native hardware-I/O errors remain visible.
Native slot 0/token-present index 0; label fixed to Cryptech Token. Independent processes and directories required per shard/client; explicit operator reset only.

general-token application profile falsified by preserved RNG failure CKR_FUNCTION_FAILED; key generation/import/signing/persistent-key paths are unqualified. No hardware fallback or provider normalization.
Release permanently unavailable: no release tags. Rolling inputs frozen; random WHEEL salt prevents a bit-for-bit reproducibility claim.
